## How to use this schedule

- **Lectures:** Mon & Wed (new content; ~2 lecture readings per week)
- **Fridays:** Catchup and review; occasional in-class activity
- **Homework:** ~10 assignments due Mondays via Canvas (two-stage: solutions → grade memo); lowest dropped
- **Readings:** Lecture readings on course website

**Textbook:** Lecture readings provided on course website (OpenStax *Astronomy 2e* for optional reference)

## Important Dates

- **First class:** Wed Jan 21, 2026
- **Module 1 Exam:** Mon Mar 2 (Observing the Sky, Light & Spectra)
- **Spring Break:** Mar 27 – Apr 5 (no class)
- **Module 2 Exam:** Mon Apr 20 (Stars, Stellar Evolution, Exoplanets)
- **Last class:** Wed May 6
- **Final Exam:** Fri May 8, 10:30 AM – 12:30 PM (Comprehensive)
